needs.premise: One admitted root task, two workers, one descendant, two bounded epochs; checkpoints and whole-round seal are abstract qualified premises; no actual C traversal, weak-memory or fairness proof

22 conditional declarations: five custody states and Step/Trace conservation, root ack versus round seal, checkpoint custody, generation checks and ranked wait graph; not all QNT actions or C source simulation
Atomic enlistment fixes task/view epoch and root obligation before any queue notification; return ticket cannot revoke owed work; producer/worker lifecycle separated
Pending-to-owned transfer binds task ID, epoch, attempt generation and worker before source queue ownership is released; reply loss queries canonical record; no second scan/replay inferred
Cooperative exit has stopped writer plus complete cursor/copy-frame/child-credit checkpoint and accepted replacement; unknown join or partial-copy outcome retains debt and blocks closure
Strong termination includes pending/owned/private/ready/quarantined root and descendant obligations, separate weak generation and cleanup; empty queues or idle count alone not proof
RootAck never implies ResumeSeal; weak continuation movement, cleanup, capacity/fudge/context preparation and synchronized result delivery complete before active permit and reload

Workers/coordinator never wait for the same return permit, metadata gate or owner-affine destructor needed by round completion; complete wait graph, finite producers, worker capacity and fairness remain source/progress duties

Task publication, claim/attempt fencing, stable Ready result, stop/checkpoint transfer and whole-round seal use proved C happens-before and lifetime ordering; no volatile-only, timeout or machine-wrap qualification

Point-specific live roots include exported GVM registers, saved values, type caches, frame/denv roots, host locals and all RC domains; address/location coverage, lifetime and writable relocation slots required; no arbitrary C-stack inference

At a qualified safepoint spill live values, close ordinary root/payload writers and raw Scheme borrowers, pin frame/root locations; publish descriptor and NativeFrozen membership together; frozen locations permit collector writeback
Active mutator ack becomes a frozen-root obligation in the same phase gate; collection includes every context generation exactly once; worker identity is independent of context or processor count
Role-qualified worker owns writable canonical cells and relocation completion; moving roots updated in place or through proved writeback mapping; global collection/mutator barriers remain required

Reentry request closes new round admission, honors already-enlisted pending/in-flight root scans, validates current epoch/roots/binding and grants active participation before reload; no second scan may race protected reload; metadata pins retire after use

Acquire callback permission before RC payload/marker access, root proc before allocation, retain suspended parent activation roots, publish fresh parent view on callback exit; unknown writers, closure identity or nonlocal exit reject transfer

Release/acquire descriptor, scan completion and phase-gate publication must order root stores and reload; no racing plain C root loads or lock-free/liveness claim; generation wrap and aliases need platform refinement

Initial relation, every real source action/stutter, concrete observation reflection and progress; claim/initialize/publish/acquire/scan/rescan/finish; source Tail and partial-copy states require extra relation

Initial relation, every real source action/stutter, concrete observation reflection and progress; freeze/last-use/drain/issue permit/reclaim; unknown outcomes retain custody; reopened generation invalidates permit

arbitrationCosts.removedWork: Released native context need not execute its own root scan
arbitrationCosts.bound: For K admitted released contexts: K root tasks remain; active ack targets N-K
arbitrationCosts.addedCost: O(K) descriptors/phase credits; enqueue/claim/ack state transitions
arbitrationCosts.condition: No removed root scan; existing roots are direct calls, so task layer is new work

arbitrationCosts.removedWork: Query a stable claim/Ready record instead of repeating effects
arbitrationCosts.bound: Zero additional scan writes for a query or duplicate acknowledgement
arbitrationCosts.addedCost: Task/epoch/attempt directory and terminal result retention
arbitrationCosts.condition: Only ready/quiescent result loss; unknown write progress cannot be replayed

arbitrationCosts.removedWork: Continue from a qualified checkpoint without rescanning known prefix
arbitrationCosts.bound: Restore cost O(Scheckpoint); no hard time bound for drain
arbitrationCosts.addedCost: Checkpoint copy-frame/cursor/child credits plus source and target pins
arbitrationCosts.condition: Stop alone or unknown join lacks complete state; arbitrary owner death remains blocked

arbitrationCosts.removedWork: Prevent empty-queue or idle-count false completion
arbitrationCosts.bound: Frontier covers pending+claimed+ready+quarantine+private+derived work; scan remains O(R+H)
arbitrationCosts.addedCost: Full-frontier accounting and separate strong/weak phase generations
arbitrationCosts.condition: Zero unsafe early completions is a correctness target, not a speedup

arbitrationCosts.removedWork: Preserve owed late claims and avoid worker waiting on requester
arbitrationCosts.bound: RootAck is earlier than whole-round ResumeSeal; no shortening below actual phase dependencies
arbitrationCosts.addedCost: Ticket/cut arbitration, phase wait and protected O(U) reload
arbitrationCosts.condition: No bound without finite producers, available worker and fair scheduling

arbitrationCosts.removedWork: Break cleanup-to-owner-return cycle only through qualified deferred custody
arbitrationCosts.bound: Retain Hforeign physical backing until actual destructor/release completion
arbitrationCosts.addedCost: Owner-affine dispatch, root/native payload transfer and release receipts
arbitrationCosts.condition: Cannot omit destructor or free still shell on enqueue alone; unqualified path refuses release profile

arbitrationCosts.removedWork: Reuse task records and existing root/frame backing only after last use
arbitrationCosts.addedCost: Retained views, root banks, suspended frames and quarantine may extend peak
arbitrationCosts.condition: Count backing once; O(K) records is not O(K) total retained heap; no peak decrease proved

arbitrationCosts.removedWork: Scheme owns coverage/FrameSpec; modern C owns typed roles, ledgers and collector adapters
arbitrationCosts.bound: Zero additional Zig runtime-work reduction established
arbitrationCosts.addedCost: Both need source closure, attempt fencing, resume seals and memory-order evidence
arbitrationCosts.condition: Language replacement cannot supply missing recovery state or remove GC phases

nodes.labelText: Worker claim + private scan\ncursor / copy frame / child credits
Drain descendants / weak phase\ncleanup + capacity + context prepare
Stopped + complete checkpoint\naccepted handoff; new generation
Unknown writer / transfer\nretain debt; refuse phase close

callers.actualChain: on_all_processors raises sync interrupt; service/execute loop arbitrates, executes and returns combined result
callers.hazard: Calling-thread and processor-count barrier coupling; an admitted root queue is a proposed replacement, not existing C code
callers.replacement: Separate round/participant service; preserve combining/result obligations

callers.actualChain: setup flips spaces, resets per-processor queues/cursors and seeds strong/weak worker counts from processor count
callers.hazard: Pool worker identity cannot replace context count or erase pending root debt
callers.replacement: Snapshot context/view duties separately from worker team

callers.actualChain: strong phase directly calls mark_continuation/registers/saved/type-cache plus processor0 RC/VM roots, then transitive scan
callers.hazard: Roots are not dequeued tasks today; removing owner participation requires explicit task publication
callers.replacement: Enlist canonical root task before released-context acknowledgement transfer

callers.actualChain: end_heap_chunk publishes marker/link then FIFO tail and signals
callers.hazard: Two ordered visibility cuts; signal is not acceptance or completion
callers.replacement: Publish child credit/payload before parent Ready; retain source ownership on unknown acceptance

callers.actualChain: local FIFO head advances under spinlock; lock released before scan_complete_heap_chunk
callers.hazard: Dequeued payload exists only in private cursor/work context while queue may appear empty
callers.replacement: Canonical owned record survives head advance; preserve pending cursor step

callers.actualChain: stealer locks source FIFO, advances head, unlocks then scans on receiving PSTATE
callers.hazard: Steal changes owner but no persistent attempt/result or death recovery record
callers.replacement: Task generation/claim receipt plus CollectorWorkContext adapter

callers.actualChain: forwarding CAS precedes payload copy; PAIR advances after mark_array; still work popped before scan; complete chunk cursor local
callers.hazard: PC or stopped thread alone loses partial-copy, Tail and descendant responsibility
callers.replacement: Full qualified checkpoint, source pins and stopped-writer transfer; otherwise quarantine

callers.actualChain: drain local still/movable, steal, decrement worker count, condition wait or zero termination
callers.hazard: Idle count assumes no unrepresented producer/private task; worker removal is not debt cancellation
callers.replacement: Close strong on full frontier; reserve service capacity; keep weak round separate

callers.actualChain: weak processes wills and moves continuation; cleanup invokes foreign destructor; resize/fudge then prepare_mem_pstate
callers.hazard: RootAck precedes later frame movement and owner-affine destructor may cycle with return
callers.replacement: ResumeSeal includes current round/capacity/context state; qualify destructor or deferred custody before freeing

callers.actualChain: returned Scheme thunk keeps servicing sync operations; resize shrink cleans/exits processors and processor0 joins ignoring error
callers.hazard: Normal processor exit is outside active scan; join call/error suppression does not prove independent worker stop
callers.replacement: Explicit role revocation and drain separate from OS join and PSTATE/root facility cleanup
